screen.legendarysurvivaloverhaul.datapac: Legendary Survival Overhaul - WARNING - CONFIG NOW ON DATAPACK

Your custom JSON configurations of Legendary Survival Overhaul are now OBSOLETE. LSO now uses DATAPACKS to REPLACE the JSON files.
A datapack-ready folder (named 'customDataPack') has been created in the config folder of LSO with all the custom values you have defined.

IF YOU PLAY ON A SERVER :

ON SERVER SIDE : 
1) Go in the legendary survival overhaul config folder (button on this screen)
2) Cut the 'customDataPack' folder
3) Go in the saves > 'Your world' > datapacks folder (still on SERVER side)
4) Paste the customDataPack folder here. Your custom configs will then work in game.

ON CLIENT SIDE : 
5) Go in the LSO config folder 
6) Remove the customDataPack & the json folders.

IF YOU PLAY LOCALLY :

Follow steps 1) to 4) but locally: cut paste the 'customDataPack' folder in the saves > 'your world' > datapacks folder.


DON'T FORGET to remove the json folder & customDataPack folders both on SERVER & CLIENT, otherwise this message will be rendered at every launch.
enchantment.legendarysurvivaloverhaul.re: Provides additional hydration and saturation when drinking from the canteen
enchantment.legendarysurvivaloverhaul.pu: Automatically purifies all water in the canteen
tooltip.legendarysurvivaloverhaul.respir: Good for breathing clean air. Keeps your stomach on speaking terms.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.air.airBladder: Air Bladder Air Refill per Tick
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.group_c: General options shared by all features. Each feature has its own config file in this folder (temperature, seasons, thirst, health, body_damage). See the data packs to customize the temperature of specific blocks, liquids, armors, etc.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.difficu: How the mod represents a challenge for the player. Accepted values are as follows: PEACEFUL - Temperature doesn't harm the player and the hydration doesn't decrease. EASY - Temperature and Thirst won't hurt the player health below 10 hearts. NORMAL - Temperature and Thirst hurts the player down to 1 heart. HARD - Temperature and Thirst can kill the player. Any other value will default to HARD.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.routine: How often player temperature, thirst, body damage and health is regularly synced between the client and server, in ticks. Lower values will increase accuracy at the cost of performance.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.compass: What information the compass returns when player is using it or in an item frame.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.showCoo: If enabled, use on a filled map will show destination coordinates.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.hideInf: If enabled, information like position and direction will be hidden from the debug screen (F3).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.group_f: Options related to the player food data
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.baseFoo: Food exhausted every 10 ticks. Increase the base minecraft food exhaustion.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.sprinti: Food exhausted every 10 ticks while sprinting in addition to the sprinting minecraft food exhaustion.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.onAttac: Food exhausted on every attack in addition to the minecraft attack food exhaustion.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.group_a: Options related to the air quality system (safety lanterns, signal torches, air bladders, respirator).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.airQual: If enabled, air quality affects breathing: bad air drains the air supply even outside of liquids, good air refills it.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.enableS: If enabled, right-clicking a normal torch with an empty main hand turns it into a (cosmetic) Signal Torch and back.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.drowned: Air supply removed by a Drowned's melee attack. Set to 0 to disable.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.yellowA: Radius in blocks for providers in the yellow air tag.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.blueAir: Radius in blocks for providers in the blue air tag.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.redAirP: Radius in blocks for providers in the red air tag.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.common.greenAi: Radius in blocks for providers in the green air tag.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.te: Temperature Enabled
Whether the temperature system is enabled. Season related temperature options are in seasons.toml.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.da: If enabled, players will take damage from the effects of high temperature.
If enabled, players will take damage from the effects of low temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.go: Chance of the ferns to become a gold fern when grow mature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.on: How much of an effect being on fire has on a player's temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.sp: How much of an effect sprinting has on a player's temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.al: How much of an effect altitude has on player's temperature. Each 64 blocks further from sea level will impact player's temperature by this value. The sea level can be defined via datapack under the dimension's temperature. As an example, a value of -6 will reduce the player's temperature by 6 for each 64 blocks (the calculus is done linearly).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.te: Temperature Immunity On Death Enabled
If enabled, players will be immune to temperature effects after death.
Temperature Immunity On Death Time
Temperature immunity period in ticks while the player is immune to temperature effects after death.
Temperature Immunity On First Spawn Enabled
If enabled, players will be immune to temperature effects on first spawn in a world.
Temperature Immunity On First Spawn Time
Temperature immunity period in ticks while the player is immune to temperature effects on first spawn.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.he: If enabled, players will also receive other effects from their current temperature state. If the player is too hot, hydration will deplete faster.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.co: If enabled, players will also receive other effects from their current temperature state. If the player is too cold, hunger will deplete faster.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.he: How much thirst exhaustion will be added every 50 ticks with no amplification effect, when the player suffers from heat.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.co: How much food exhaustion will be added every 50 ticks with no amplification effect, when the player suffers from frostbite. As reference, the hunger effect add 0.025 food exhaustion every 50 ticks.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.we: List of mounts that provide a wetness immunity.
How much being wet influences the player's temperature. It means that for a value of -10, the body temperature of the player is reduced by 10.
How frequently the wetness is modified. By default, every 10 ticks, the wetness will either increase or decrease, based on the conditions.
How much the wetness decrease when out of water.
How much the wetness increase when under rain.

How much the wetness increase when the player is in a fluid, scale by the amount of fluid in the block. The defined value is for a full block of fluid, and goes up to 2 times this value when fully immerge.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.pl: How much nearby players increase the ambient temperature by. Note that this value stacks!
The radius, in blocks, around which players will add to each other's temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.bi: How much a biome's temperature effects are multiplied.
Whether biomes will have an effect on a player's temperature.

How much hot biome's dryness will make nights really cold. Affects only dry (minecraft down fall <0.2) and hot biome. 1 means no dryness effect; 0.5 means the biome temp will be divided by 2 at the middle of the night.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.gr: The underground effect starts apply at Start Distance to the world surface. The underground effect will linearly apply a multiplier on the biome temperature, and averages the time and season temperature effects.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.un: How much a biomes temperature effects are multiplied when player is underground
Start Distance To World Surface For Underground Effect
Distance to the World Surface where underground effect will start to be applied. Smaller distance, no underground effect are applied.
End Distance To World Surface For Underground Effect

Distance to the World Surface where underground effect will be maximal. Bigger distance, the underground effect is maximal. Between the Start and End Distance, the increase of underground effect is linear.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.ra: How much of an effect rain has on temperature. It means that for a value of -2, the body temperature of the player is reduced by 2.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.sn: How much of an effect snow has on temperature. It means that for a value of -6, the body temperature of the player is reduced by 6.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.gr: Freeze effect increases while inside snow powder.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.va: If enabled, the player suffers vanilla freeze when inside powder snow.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.ma: How much of an effect freeze has on temperature when reaching maximum tick time. Starts at 0 and increases linearly.
How long in tick before freeze modifier reaches its maximum effect.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.ti: How much Time has effect on Temperature. Maximum effect at noon (positive) and midnight (negative), following a sinusoidal
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.bi: How strongly time in extreme temperature biomes affect player's temperature. Extreme temperature biomes (like snowy taiga, deserts, ...) will multiply the time based temperature by this value, while temperate biome won't be affected by this value, following a linear.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.sh: Staying in the shade or during cloudy weather will reduce player's temperature by this amount based on time of the day (maximum effect at noon, following sinusoidal). It means that for a value of -6, the body temperature of the player is reduced by 6. Only effective when reaching the threshold and during day time!
Defines when the biome temperature added by the season temperature (if seasons mod loaded) will trigger a shade effect.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.gr: Add a heating resistance on armors.
Add a cooling resistance on armors.
Add a temperature resistance on armors that can both heat and cool the player.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.te: Temperature Influence Maximum Distance
Maximum influence distance, in blocks, where thermal sources will have an effect on temperature.
Temperature Influence Up Distance Multiplier
How strongly influence distance above the player is reduced for thermal sources to have an effect on temperature.
Temperature Influence In Water Distance Multiplier
How strongly influence distance in water is reduced for thermal sources to have an effect on temperature. The under water maximum distance is defined as the maximum distance * this value
Temperature Influence Outside Distance Multiplier
How strongly influence distance outside a structure is reduced for thermal sources to have an effect on temperature. The outside maximum distance is defined as the maximum distance * this value
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.gr: The player's temperature will be adjusted at each temperature tick time, by an amount of temperature defined between the minimum and the maximum temperature modification adjusted linearly.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.te: Temperature Tick Time
Amount of time in ticks between 2 player temperature modification. The bigger is this value, the more time it takes between temperature adjustments.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.ma: Maximum amount of temperature the player's temperature can be modified at each temperature tick time. Correspond to the amount of temperature given when temperature difference is maximum, meaning 40.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.mi: Minimum amount of temperature the player's temperature can be modified at each temperature tick time. Correspond to the amount of temperature given when there is no temperature difference
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.gr: If TerraFirmaCraft is installed, then biome, time, season (if serene seasons installed) and altitude modifiers will be disabled, and TerraFirmaCraft calculation used instead. All other modifiers remain to calculate Player temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.temperature.tf: How much the heat of the item provided by TerraFirmaCraft is multiplied. 0 deactivates the impact on temperature.
How much the temperature given from TerraFirmaCraft is multiplied. 0 deactivates the impact on temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.group_: Temperature options for the Serene Seasons integration.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.serene: If Serene Seasons is installed, whether the seasons have an effect on the player's temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.ssTrop: If enabled, tropical biomes use Serene Seasons wet and dry seasons instead of the normal seasons.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.ssSeas: If season cards are enabled, season cards will appear at every season changes.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.ssDefa: If default season is enabled, when serene season defines no season effect in a biome, the normal season temperature will be applied. If disabled, when serene season defines no season effects, no season temperature will be applied.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.group_: Temperature options for the Ecliptic Seasons integration.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.eclipt: If Ecliptic Seasons is installed, whether the seasons have an effect on the player's temperature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.seasons.group_: Temperature modifiers per season. Each season is subdivided in 6 sub seasons. The value is reached at the middle of the sub season, and smoothly transition from one to another.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.thirstE: Whether the thirst system is enabled.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.dangero: If enabled, players will take damage from the complete dehydration.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.cumulat: If enabled, each time the player receives a thirst effect, its duration will be added to the thirst effect duration if already on the player.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.dehydra: Scaling of the damages dealt when completely dehydrated. Each tick damage will be increased by this value.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.thirstE: How much thirst exhaustion will be added every 50 ticks when the player suffers from non amplified Thirst Effect. The player will suffer Thirst Effect from dirty water for example.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.sprinti: Hydration exhausted when sprinting, replacing the base hydration exhausted.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.onBlock: Hydration exhausted on every block break.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.selfWat: If enabled, the player can water himself by using the canteen while crouching. This will increase the player wetness and remove fire.
If Self Watering Canteen and Wetness are enabled, defines how much wetness is added to the player. Set this value to 0 to have no wetness added. By default, the maximum wetness is 400.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.canteen: Capacity of the canteen used to store water.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.largeCa: Capacity of the large canteen used to store water.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.allowOv: Allow override of purified water stored in canteen with normal water.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.group_n: Allows drinking from lava. Can be used as bauble.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.hydrati: Amount of hydration recovered when drinking from lava.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.saturat: Amount of saturation recovered when drinking from lava.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.glassBo: Glass Bottle Loot After Drinking A Juice
Whether the player retrieves a glass bottle after drinking a juice.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.thirst.thirstE: If Vampirism is installed and if thirst enabled while being a vampire, keep the thirst system in addition to the vampiric one. If disabled, the thirst system will be disabled for vampires.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.healthO: Whether the overhaul health system is enabled.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.initial: How much health player will have initially.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.maxAddi: How much of Additional Health a player can accumulate. 2 Heath means a full heart.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.healthR: How much health ratio are recovered from bed sleeping.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.natural: If enabled, the player can regenerate health naturally if their hunger is full enough (doesn't affect external healing, such as golden apples, the Regeneration effect, etc.)
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.customH: Enable custom health regeneration when natural regen is off. Consumes saturation and hunger.
Amount of health to regenerate per tick rate.
How often in ticks health regenerates. 20 ticks = 1s
Food exhaustion per health point regenerated.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.maxShie: How much of Shield Health a player can accumulate. 2 Shield Heath means a full shield. Shield Health are lost when the player suffers damages and can't regenerate. Works similarly as the Minecraft Absorption.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.absorpt: Override the absorption effect by a shield health increase of 2. The absorption is typically given by the Golden Apple.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.heartsL: The number of Hearts lost on death.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.permane: The number of Hearts below which player can't lose hearts upon death. The hearts below this limit are de facto Permanent Hearts.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.group_b: Broken Hearts are an interaction with the localized body damage feature. Enables both feature to have it. Broken Hearts are lost hearts when a player's limb is severely injured and it can be recovered by healing the injured limb.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.resilie: Minimum Amount Of Player's Heart With Broken Hearts (Broken Heart Resilience)

The Resilient Hearts is the number of heart below which Broken Hearts can no longer be added. By default, the player has 2 resilient heart, meaning no matter the amount of broken hearts, the player won't go below 2 hearts.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.health.brokenH: Added Broken Hearts Per Injured Limb
Amount of Broken Hearts added per limbs fully injured.
Broken Hearts Per Injured Limb Mode

How broken hearts inflicted per injured limbs are calculated. The total amount will be round down to have an integer amount of broken hearts. For example, if the amount per injured limb is 0.1 with mode Player Dynamic and the player has 3 limbs injured, the total amount is 3 * (0.1 * 20), 20 being the default player max health, so 6 broken hearts will be inflicted. Accepted values are as follows: SIMPLE - The broken heart amount is a fixed value defined in Broken Hearts Per Injured Limb. PLAYER_DYNAMIC - The broken heart amount is a percentage value of the player max health using the percentage value defined in Broken Hearts Per Injured Limb. LIMB_DYNAMIC - The broken heart amount is a percentage value of the injured limb max health using the percentage value defined in Broken Hearts Per Injured Limb. Any other value will default to SIMPLE.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.lo: Whether body members receive localized damages. The damageSourceBodyParts.json allows you to define for specific damage source, the damage spread across specified body parts. The damage distribution can either be ONE_OF or ALL. ALL means the damage are equally divided across all body parts.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.he: Multiply the damage taken by the player when shot in the head without helmet.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.bo: How much of the hurt player's damage is assigned to the body parts.
How much health ratio are recovered in all body parts from bed sleeping.
How much food is exhausted when a limb regenerates based on the amount of health regenerated. For each 1 health regenerated, the food is exhausted by this value.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.mi: The hunger bar won't drop below this value while body is healing. Each hunger icon has a value of 2 in the hunger bar.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.pa: How long in ticks is the Addiction Effect lasting. 0 deactivates the feature. The Addiction Effect prevents you from re-using the morphine item.
Passive Limb Regeneration On Full Health
The limbs will be healed when the player is at max health.
The limbs will be healed when the player is under one of the mentioned effect, the most damaged limb first.

Whether the amplification of the effect increase the limb regeneration speed. The speed increase follows the same logic as the Regeneration Effect Amplification : Amplifier 1 -> tick timer /2, Amplifier 2 -> tick timer /4, ...
Amount of limb health regenerated, the most damaged limb first.
How fast in ticks the limbs regenerate passively. 20 ticks = 1s
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.pr: Minimum health threshold (as ratio of max health minus broken hearts) to start regenerating limbs.
Proportional Limb Regen Min Heal Value
Minimum limb heal value per tick rate when at min threshold. Spread proportionally across all body parts.
Proportional Limb Regen Max Heal Value
Maximum limb heal value per tick rate when at full health. Spread proportionally across all body parts.
How often in ticks the proportional regeneration occurs. 20 ticks = 1s
Rate at which healing increases from min to max. 1.0 = linear, >1 = exponential.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.gr: The First Aid Supplies overrides the passive limb regeneration as its effects is meant to be stronger.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.fi: First Aid Supplies Limb Health Regenerated
The First Aid Supplies regenerate limb health passively, either by holding it or equipping it as a trinket, the most damaged limb first.
First Aid Supplies Limb Regeneration Mode

How a player's limb health regenerated is defined. Accepted values are as follows: SIMPLE - The limb health regenerated is a fixed value defined in First Aid Supplies Limb Health Regenerated. PLAYER_DYNAMIC - The limb health regenerated is a percentage value of the player max health using the percentage value defined in First Aid Supplies Limb Health Regenerated. LIMB_DYNAMIC - The limb health regenerated is a percentage value of the limb max health using the percentage value defined in First Aid Supplies Limb Health Regenerated. Any other value will default to SIMPLE.
Whether the exceeded limb health regenerated will heal the next most damaged limb. Only available for Regeneration Mode SIMPLE or PLAYER_DYNAMIC.
How fast in ticks the First Aid Supplies will heal limbs. 20 ticks = 1s
Whether the First Aid Supplies exhaust food when healing limbs, such as the other healing items.
First Aid Supplies Boosted On Effects
The First Aid Supplies will heal limbs faster when the player is under one of the mentioned effect.
First Aid Supplies Tick Timer Multiplier
How much the First Aid Supplies tick timer is multiplied when boosted. A value of 1 would deactivate the speed boost. 0.5 makes the heal twice faster.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.re: Amount of player health regenerated by the Recovery Effect every effect tick. For comparison, the Regeneration Effect healing amount is 1.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.mo: Painkiller effect duration in ticks. This effect prevents the player to be affected by broken limbs effects.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.bo: How a player's body part health is determined. Accepted values are as follows: SIMPLE - Body parts will have initial fixed values. The body parts health define the health value. In this case, if the 'headPartHeath = 10', the head will have '10' health. DYNAMIC - Body parts will have dynamic values based on the player's max health. In this case, the body parts health is a multiplier of the player's max health. In this case, if the 'headPartHeath = 0.3', the head will have '0.3' * 'player max health' health. Any other value will default to SIMPLE.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.ar: Both arms will have this health.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.le: Both legs will have this health.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.fe: Both feet will have this health.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.gr: Each effect, threshold and amplifier lists must have the same number of items. The first effect will be triggered with the first amplifier value when the first threshold is reach.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.he: The list of effects that will be triggered when the head is damaged by the percentage of remaining head health defined in the thresholds.
The list of amplifiers the effect will have. 0 means the basic effect, 1 means the effect is amplified once.
The list of thresholds for which each effect will be triggered. A threshold is a percentage of remaining head health. 0 means the head is fully damaged.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.bo: These effects will be triggered when both arms reach the thresholds. If a same effect is used with a higher amplifier, the higher prevails (normal Minecraft behaviour).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.body_damage.mo: Painkiller Addiction effect prevents the abusive usage of Painkiller effect that prevents all negative effects from limbs. Syringe Morphine share the same configuration as Morphine item
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.foodSat: If enabled, the food saturation will be rendered on the Food Bar while the player suffers Cold Hunger Effect (secondary temperature effect).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.showVan: Whether the vanilla animation of the Food bar and Hydration bar is rendered. The bar shakes more the lower they are. This mod render a new food bar as a secondary effect of a cold temperature. Disable this animation if the temperature secondary effect is enabled to allow a compatibility with other mods rendering the food bar (for example Appleskin).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.tempera: How temperature is displayed. Accepted values are as follows: SYMBOL - Display the player's current temperature as a symbol above the hotbar. NONE - Disable the temperature indicator.
The X and Y offset of the temperature indicator. Set both to 0 for no offset.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.bodyTem: The X and Y offset of the body temperature, shown when the thermometer is equipped as a Trinkets accessory. Set both to 0 for no offset.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.heatTem: If enabled, player will see a foggy effect when the heat is high.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.coldTem: If enabled, player will see a frost effect when the cold is low.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.breathi: If enabled, breathing sound can be heard while player faces harsh temperatures.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.coldBre: Temperature threshold below which a cold breath effect is rendered by the player. -1000 disable the feature.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.renderT: If enabled, render the temperature values in Fahrenheit.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.wetness: The X and Y offset of the wetness indicator. Set both to 0 for no offset.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.bodyDam: The X and Y offset of the body damage indicator. Set both to 0 for no offset. By default, render next to the inventory bar.
Body Damage Indicator Limb Health Threshold

Limb health threshold below which the body damage indicator is rendered. If set to 1.1, the body damage indicator is always rendered. If set to 1.0, the body damage indicator is rendered as soon as a limb is wounded.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.seasonC: The X and Y offset of the season cards. Set both to 0 for no offset. By default, render first top quarter vertically and centered horizontally.
The delay before rendering the season card at first player spawn or player dimension change.
Season Cards Display Time In Ticks
The display time in ticks that the season card will be fully rendered.
Season Cards Fade in In Ticks
The fade in time in ticks that the season card will appear.
Season Cards Fade Out In Ticks
The fade out time in ticks that the season card will disappear.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.showHyd: If enabled, show the hydration values in the item tooltip.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.mergeHy: If enabled, show the hydration and the saturation values on the same line in the tooltip.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.hydrati: Whether the Hydration Saturation is displayed or not.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.lowHydr: If enabled, player's vision will become blurry when running low on hydration.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.showHyd: If enabled, the hydration bar will be displayed.
If enabled, the Hydration Exhaustion will be displayed (grey bar behind the hydration bar).
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.showDri: If enabled, a preview on hydration bar will be displayed if player holds a drink item.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.hydrati: How much the hydration bar is moved to the right.
How much the hydration bar is moved to the bottom.
legendarysurvivaloverhaul.client.appendB: Append Broken/Shield Hearts To Health Bar
